text_block_list.text: One day, when visiting the library...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Please... I beseech you!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: O-Opera O? This is a library...
text_block_list.name: Зенно Роб Рой

text_block_list.text:
Oh! A thousand pardons. To violate the
library's
code of conduct is a betrayal of
beauty itself. As
such... Ahem...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Please... I beseech you...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Um, your voice is softer this time, but...
text_block_list.name: Зенно Роб Рой

text_block_list.text:
Ah, fine trainer. Assist me in my
endeavor, would
you?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
For she is the scholar of songs who holds

knowledge of the composition I seek.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Th-that phrasing is somewhat
perplexing...
text_block_list.name: Зенно Роб Рой

text_block_list.text:
I ask for a quick summary to get up to
speed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As it turns out, Т.М. Опера О has come
here to
ask Зенно Роб Рой for opera
recommendations.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She is a veritable fountain of knowledge!
I would
invite her expertise for the
benefit of my
dramaturgy!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Th-that's... You're exaggerating.
text_block_list.name: Зенно Роб Рой

text_block_list.text:
I-I simply like to read books. I'm
nowhere near
qualified to handle such a
high request.
text_block_list.name: Зенно Роб Рой

text_block_list.text: Rob Roy.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: ...Yes?
text_block_list.name: Зенно Роб Рой

text_block_list.text: I am beautiful.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Huh? W-well, yes... you are.
text_block_list.name: Зенно Роб Рой

text_block_list.text: Then no other words are necessary.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Зенно Роб Рой is beyond confused. It
looks like I
need to step in.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There are none. When an assessment is
made, it
must be made rightly. Am I
wrong?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy, your intimate knowledge of
books runs
deЭпизод You should be praised
for it and proud of
it.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Never should it be taken lightly, even by
yourself.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: You both think so?
text_block_list.name: Зенно Роб Рой

text_block_list.text:
So, I beg of you once again—might you

recommend a play worthy of one such as
I?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Very well. I'll pick what I consider to be
the finest
of works!
text_block_list.name: Зенно Роб Рой

text_block_list.text:
Зенно Роб Рой comes back with two
scripts of
recommendation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: The one we decide to read first is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: An epic about a racing deity.
The tale of a heroic savior of the people.

text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, what a coincidence. I have
been
meaning to read that very one!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Opera O and I absorb ourselves in the
story.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What is it thou desires?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Speed? So be it... Now, go forth.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, what a coincidence. I have
been
meaning to read that very one!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Um, Opera O! I've procured another
book for you
today!
text_block_list.name: Зенно Роб Рой

text_block_list.text:
Ah! Thank you... Hehe, I can hardly wait
to read
it.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Yes, I have the urge to read more heroic
tales.
People yearn for heroes of all
shapes and sizes.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Heh... It seems the hero of her dreams
and I, the
Overlord, somewhat differ.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Reading books seems to have helped
T.M. Opera
O come to a realization.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure what's come over T.M.
Opera O, but
it's having a positive effect
on her running.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
